prompt.en: In what year did the Government of Canada apologize for the Head Tax imposed on Chinese immigrants?
prompt.fr: En quelle année le gouvernement du Canada a-t-il présenté des excuses pour la taxe d'entrée imposée aux immigrants chinois?

explanation.en: Chinese and European crews laid the track together. Once it was finished, Chinese workers met open discrimination, including a fee charged at the border because of their race — the Head Tax. Canada apologized for it in 2006.
explanation.fr: Des équipes chinoises et européennes ont posé la voie ensemble. Une fois le travail terminé, les travailleurs chinois ont subi une discrimination ouverte, dont un droit exigé à la frontière en raison de leur race : la taxe d'entrée. Le Canada s'en est excusé en 2006.

source.quote: Afterwards the Chinese were subject to discrimination, including the Head Tax, a race-based entry fee. The Government of Canada apologized in 2006 for this discriminatory policy.

verification.evidence: The project was financed by British and American investors and built by both European and Chinese labour. Afterwards the Chinese were subject to discrimination, including the Head Tax, a race-based entry fee. The Government of Canada apologized in 2006 for this discriminatory policy.
